name: Ollama
description: Chat with language models that run inside a VM, using the real Ollama server. Your conversations never leave the Mac; the only network access is pulling the models you choose from Ollama's registry. Runs on the VM's CPUs; the Mac's GPU is an optional, experimental extra.

network.purpose: Ollama's model registry: it tells the app which files make up the model you pull. Nothing about you or your chats is sent.
Ollama's storage on Cloudflare R2: the registry redirects every model download to this host, where the model files are served.
